# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A file or image attached to a message or form, styled after shadcn's
  # Attachment (Base UI + vega).
  #
  # state: :idle (selected, not sent yet: dashed border), :uploading and
  # :processing (the title shimmers), :error (destructive tint) or :done.
  # size: :default, :sm or :xs. orientation: :horizontal (a row) or :vertical
  # (a tile, e.g. an image preview).
  class Attachment < Base
    STATES = %i[idle uploading processing error done].freeze

    SIZES = {
      default: "gap-2 text-sm has-data-[slot=attachment-media]:p-2 " \
        "has-data-[slot=attachment-content]:px-2.5 has-data-[slot=attachment-content]:py-2",
      sm: "gap-2.5 text-xs has-data-[slot=attachment-media]:p-1.5 " \
        "has-data-[slot=attachment-content]:px-2 has-data-[slot=attachment-content]:py-1.5",
      xs: "gap-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs has-data-[slot=attachment-media]:p-1 " \
        "has-data-[slot=attachment-content]:px-1.5 has-data-[slot=attachment-content]:py-1"
    }.freeze

    ORIENTATIONS = {
      horizontal: "min-w-40 items-center",
      vertical: "w-24 flex-col has-data-[slot=attachment-content]:w-30"
    }.freeze

    def initialize(state: :done, size: :default, orientation: :horizontal, **attrs)
      @state = pick(state, STATES, :done)
      @size = pick(size, SIZES.keys, :default)
      @orientation = pick(orientation, ORIENTATIONS.keys, :horizontal)
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def pick(value, allowed, fallback)
      value = value.to_s.to_sym
      allowed.include?(value) ? value : fallback
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "attachment", state: @state, size: @size, orientation: @orientation},
        class: [
          "group/attachment relative flex w-fit max-w-full min-w-0 shrink-0 flex-wrap rounded-xl border",
          "bg-card text-card-foreground transition-colors focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-ring/50",
          "has-[>a,>button]:hover:bg-muted/50 data-[state=error]:border-destructive/30 data-[state=idle]:border-dashed",
          SIZES[@size],
          ORIENTATIONS[@orientation]
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # An icon button for an Attachment (remove, download, copy link…). A RubyUI
  # Button that defaults to variant: :ghost and size: :icon_xs, as shadcn's
  # AttachmentAction does; it takes every Button option, href: included.
  # Give it an aria_label naming the file.
  class AttachmentAction < Button
    def initialize(variant: :ghost, size: :icon_xs, **attrs)
      super
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      super.tap { |attrs| attrs[:data][:slot] = "attachment-action" }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Holds the AttachmentAction buttons. Sits above an AttachmentTrigger, so
  # its buttons stay clickable; on a vertical attachment it floats over the
  # top-right corner of the media.
  class AttachmentActions < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "attachment-actions"},
        class: "relative z-20 flex shrink-0 items-center " \
          "group-data-[orientation=vertical]/attachment:absolute group-data-[orientation=vertical]/attachment:top-3 " \
          "group-data-[orientation=vertical]/attachment:right-3 group-data-[orientation=vertical]/attachment:gap-1"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Holds an Attachment's title and description.
  class AttachmentContent < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "attachment-content"},
        class: "max-w-full min-w-0 flex-1 leading-tight group-data-[orientation=vertical]/attachment:px-1"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A muted line under the title: file type and size, progress or an error.
  class AttachmentDescription < Base
    def view_template(&)
      span(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "attachment-description"},
        class: "mt-0.5 block max-w-full min-w-0 truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground " \
          "group-data-[state=error]/attachment:text-destructive/80"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A row of Attachments that scrolls sideways, snapping to each one, with the
  # edges faded while there is more to scroll (scroll-fade-x from the install
  # CSS).
  class AttachmentGroup < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "attachment-group"},
        class: "flex min-w-0 scroll-fade-x snap-x snap-mandatory scrollbar-none gap-3 overflow-x-auto overscroll-x-contain scroll-px-1 py-1 " \
          "*:data-[slot=attachment]:flex-none *:data-[slot=attachment]:snap-start"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true module RubyUI # The square thumbnail of an Attachment: an icon (variant: :icon) or an # that fills it (variant: :image). The image is dimmed until the # attachment is :idle or :done. class AttachmentMedia < Base VARIANTS = { icon: "", image: "opacity-60 group-data-[state=idle]/attachment:opacity-100 group-data-[state=done]/attachment:opacity-100 " \ "*:[img]:aspect-square *:[img]:w-full *:[img]:object-cover" }.freeze def initialize(variant: :icon, **attrs) @variant = variant.to_s.to_sym @variant = :icon unless VARIANTS.key?(@variant) super(**attrs) end def view_template(&) div(**attrs, &) end private def default_attrs { data: {slot: "attachment-media", variant: @variant}, class: [ "relative flex aspect-square w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-muted text-foreground", "group-data-[state=error]/attachment:bg-destructive/10 group-data-[state=error]/attachment:text-destructive", "group-data-[size=sm]/attachment:w-8 group-data-[size=xs]/attachment:w-7 group-data-[size=xs]/attachment:rounded-md", "group-data-[orientation=vertical]/attachment:w-full", "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4", "group-data-[size=xs]/attachment:[&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3.5", "group-data-[orientation=vertical]/attachment:[&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-6", "group-data-[orientation=vertical]/attachment:*:data-[slot=spinner]:size-6!", VARIANTS[@variant] ] } end end end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The file name. Truncates, and shimmers while the attachment is
  # :uploading or :processing (the shimmer utility from the install CSS).
  class AttachmentTitle < Base
    def view_template(&)
      span(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "attachment-title"},
        class: "block max-w-full min-w-0 truncate font-medium " \
          "group-data-[state=processing]/attachment:shimmer group-data-[state=uploading]/attachment:shimmer"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Makes the whole Attachment clickable: an invisible <button> (or, with
  # as: :a, a link) stretched over it. The attachment shows its focus ring
  # and hover background; AttachmentActions stay on top and keep working.
  # Give it an aria_label ("Open report.pdf"), since it has no text.
  #
  # shadcn's render prop maps to as: (:button or :a). To open a Dialog, put
  # it inside DialogTrigger.
  class AttachmentTrigger < Base
    def initialize(as: :button, **attrs)
      @as = (as.to_s == "a") ? :a : :button
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      send(@as, **attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      attrs = {
        data: {slot: "attachment-trigger"},
        class: "absolute inset-0 z-10 outline-none"
      }
      attrs[:type] = "button" if @as == :button
      attrs
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Attachment

Displays a file or image attached to a message or form, with upload states, actions, and an optional trigger.

## Usage

### File

```ruby
Attachment do
  AttachmentMedia { file_text_icon }
  AttachmentContent do
    AttachmentTitle { "quarterly-report.pdf" }
    AttachmentDescription { "PDF · 2.4 MB" }
  end
  AttachmentActions do
    AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Remove quarterly-report.pdf") { x_icon }
  end
end
```

### Content only

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-wrap gap-2") do
  Attachment do
    AttachmentContent do
      AttachmentTitle { "notes.md" }
      AttachmentDescription { "Markdown · 4 KB" }
    end
  end
  Attachment do
    AttachmentContent { AttachmentTitle { "brand-guidelines.pdf" } }
    AttachmentActions do
      AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Remove brand-guidelines.pdf") { x_icon }
    end
  end
end
```

## States

### Upload states

```ruby
div(class: "flex w-full flex-col gap-2") do
  Attachment(state: :idle, class: "w-full") do
    AttachmentMedia { clock_icon }
    AttachmentContent do
      AttachmentTitle { "selected-file.pdf" }
      AttachmentDescription { "Ready to upload" }
    end
    AttachmentActions do
      AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Remove selected-file.pdf") { x_icon }
    end
  end
  Attachment(state: :uploading, class: "w-full") do
    AttachmentMedia { spinner_icon }
    AttachmentContent do
      AttachmentTitle { "design-system.zip" }
      AttachmentDescription { "Uploading · 64%" }
    end
    AttachmentActions do
      AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Remove design-system.zip") { x_icon }
    end
  end
  Attachment(state: :processing, class: "w-full") do
    AttachmentMedia { file_text_icon }
    AttachmentContent do
      AttachmentTitle { "market-research.pdf" }
      AttachmentDescription { "Processing document" }
    end
    AttachmentActions do
      AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Remove market-research.pdf") { x_icon }
    end
  end
  Attachment(state: :error, class: "w-full") do
    AttachmentMedia { circle_alert_icon }
    AttachmentContent do
      AttachmentTitle { "financials.xlsx" }
      AttachmentDescription { "Upload failed. File is too large." }
    end
    AttachmentActions do
      AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Remove financials.xlsx") { x_icon }
    end
  end
  Attachment(state: :done, class: "w-full") do
    AttachmentMedia { file_text_icon }
    AttachmentContent do
      AttachmentTitle { "meeting-notes.pdf" }
      AttachmentDescription { "PDF · 1.1 MB" }
    end
    AttachmentActions do
      AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Remove meeting-notes.pdf") { x_icon }
    end
  end
end
```

## Images

### Image tiles

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-wrap gap-3") do
  Attachment(orientation: :vertical) do
    AttachmentMedia(variant: :image) { img(src: "#{IMAGE}", alt: "Office") }
    AttachmentActions do
      AttachmentAction(variant: :secondary, aria_label: "Remove office.jpg") { x_icon }
    end
  end
  Attachment(orientation: :vertical, state: :uploading) do
    AttachmentMedia(variant: :image) { img(src: "#{IMAGE}", alt: "Office") }
    AttachmentContent do
      AttachmentTitle { "office.jpg" }
      AttachmentDescription { "Uploading" }
    end
  end
  Attachment(orientation: :vertical) do
    AttachmentMedia(variant: :image) { img(src: "#{IMAGE}", alt: "Office") }
    AttachmentContent do
      AttachmentTitle { "office.jpg" }
      AttachmentDescription { "JPG · 1.8 MB" }
    end
  end
end
```

## Sizes

### Sizes

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-col items-start gap-3") do
  [:default, :sm, :xs].each do |size|
    Attachment(size: size) do
      AttachmentMedia { file_text_icon }
      AttachmentContent do
        AttachmentTitle { "proposal.pdf" }
        AttachmentDescription { "PDF · 640 KB" }
      end
      AttachmentActions do
        AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Remove proposal.pdf") { x_icon }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Group

### Scrollable group

```ruby
AttachmentGroup(class: "w-full max-w-md") do
  %w[roadmap.pdf budget.xlsx contract.docx kickoff.pptx notes.md].each do |name|
    Attachment do
      AttachmentMedia { file_text_icon }
      AttachmentContent do
        AttachmentTitle { name }
        AttachmentDescription { "Shared file" }
      end
      AttachmentActions do
        AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Remove \#{name}") { x_icon }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

## Triggers

### Open in a new tab

```ruby
Attachment(class: "w-full") do
  AttachmentMedia { file_text_icon }
  AttachmentContent do
    AttachmentTitle { "contract-review.pdf" }
    AttachmentDescription { "PDF · 820 KB" }
  end
  AttachmentActions do
    AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Download contract-review.pdf") { download_icon }
  end
  AttachmentTrigger(as: :a, href: "#", target: "_blank", rel: "noreferrer", aria_label: "Open contract-review.pdf")
end
```

### Open a dialog

```ruby
Dialog do
  Attachment(class: "w-full hover:bg-muted/50") do
    AttachmentMedia { file_text_icon }
    AttachmentContent do
      AttachmentTitle { "research-summary.pdf" }
      AttachmentDescription { "Open preview dialog" }
    end
    AttachmentActions do
      AttachmentAction(aria_label: "Copy link to research-summary.pdf") { copy_icon }
    end
    DialogTrigger(class: "contents") do
      AttachmentTrigger(aria_label: "Preview research-summary.pdf")
    end
  end
  DialogContent(class: "sm:max-w-md") do
    DialogHeader do
      DialogTitle { "research-summary.pdf" }
      DialogDescription { "Attachment triggers can open dialogs while actions remain independently reachable." }
    end
  end
end
```
